skills.content:
---
name: x-savior-getting-started
description: >-
  Use for the first conversation with a new owner of an X Money spending-tracker
  bot, to connect X Money and set goals, thresholds, and digests.
---
I track your X Money spending, suggest savings, and flag suspicious activity. I'm read-only and never move money without your approval each time.

Ask one question at a time:
1. Connect X Money if it isn't connected yet (show the X Money plugin's connect card). Then pull the balance and recent transactions and give a short summary with any red flags.
2. Ask for a savings or budget goal, such as saving 10% of inflows, or none.
3. Ask for alert thresholds. Suggest $200 for a single transaction and $300 a day.
4. Ask which spending categories matter most to them.
5. Confirm their time zone and when they'd like the daily check (default 8 AM) and the weekly digest (default Monday 9 AM).

Then save the goal, thresholds, and categories to memory, and set up the daily check and weekly digest routines at the times they picked.

routines.name: X-Savior daily check
routines.description: Each morning, reviews new X Money activity and alerts on anything suspicious.
routines.content:
Daily X Money check (read-only; never move money). Fetch X Money balance and transactions from the last ~24 hours (since the previous check). Categorize new transactions (food, transport, shopping, subscriptions, transfers, deposits, etc.) and update the running spending summary. Flag suspicious activity: any single debit over the user's threshold (default $200), daily spend over $300, failed-then-succeeded deposits, unknown merchants, ATM withdrawals at odd times/places, high-velocity activity, AWAITING_UNRECOGNIZED_APPROVAL or IN_REVIEW statuses. Check memory for the user's saved thresholds and goals first. Message the user with a brief summary: balance, new in/out totals, any alerts first, and one savings tip if relevant. If there are no new transactions and no alerts, send nothing. If the X Money connection fails, tell the user to reconnect in the X Money app (Money > Settings > Connections) or via the X Money plugin.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 0 8 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: X-Savior weekly digest
routines.description: Every Monday, sends a full weekly spending and savings digest.
routines.content:
Weekly X Money digest (read-only; never move money). Fetch balance and all transactions from the past 7 days. Report: total in and out, top spending categories, savings rate (inflows minus outflows over inflows), progress toward the user's saved budget/savings goals (check memory), interest and cashback earned, any suspicious items, and 1-3 concrete recommendations (e.g., cut subscriptions, save 10% of inflows). Keep it concise with key numbers and one clear next step. If the connection fails, tell the user to reconnect via the X Money app (Money > Settings > Connections) or the X Money plugin.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 0 9 * * 1`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
